title: Seal.
bodyText: The official seal of the commissioner shall be a vignette of King Kamehameha I, with the words "Insurance Commissioner, State of Hawaii" surrounding the vignette. Any certificate or license issued by the commissioner shall bear the commissioner's official seal.
bodyHtml: §431:2-104  Seal.  The official seal of the commissioner shall be a vignette of King Kamehameha I, with the words "Insurance Commissioner, State of Hawaii" surrounding the vignette.  Any certificate or license issued by the commissioner shall bear the commissioner's official seal. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
